summary: Fresh independent canonical audit of the pinned post-curation extraction. All 88 Chinese source units, all 81 current temporal or active-hint items, and all 27 people were reviewed. Claims 48 and 53 now correctly record the discrete AD 948 accession, p004/p005 hints match it, and the invented former claim 206 is absent. Claim 205 faithfully preserves the Qianyou AD 948–950 interval, but its explicit unresolved chronology and p027’s non-hold active hint keep the chapter from approval.
